To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of platform boundary resources is a key driver of third-party development and that platform boundary resources are designed and used by platform owners to balance platform control and external contributions.

(1) platform boundary resources can be designed and used to achieve two conflicting goals in third-party development, namely the maintenance of platform (i) control and (ii) design capability, (2) the two goals can be achieved through two different sets of actions, namely (a) resourcing and (b) securing, (3) resourcing and securing actions can be further divided into four specialised constructs, and (4) resourcing and regulating securing are used by platform owners, whereas diversity

the boundary resources of an open platform, which are designed to facilitate and secure third-party development, are used by the platform owner and third-party developers in ways that both secure and resource the platform and its owner, but that these two drivers can conflict with one another.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of platform boundary resources in third-party development and how these resources are used to balance platform control and external contributions.
how the design of a platform boundary resource influences the development of a platform ecosystem.
the role of boundary resources in third-party development and the interplay between resourcing and securing in platform control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the boundary resource model provides a theoretical framework for understanding how platform stakeholders balance platform control and external design contributions.
the platform control and external contributions can be achieved by the boundary resources model.
boundary resources design and third-party development is a process that is driven by the need to maintain platform control and secure the platform’s future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
boundary resources are not only a means for securing a platform but also a resource for resourcing a platform ecosystem.
boundary resources are a doubleedged sword for platform control.
boundary resources are the means by which platform providers balance platform control and external development contribution in third-party platform development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of boundary resources is a balancing act between the platform’s control and its contribution to third-party development.
platform control is not a binary choice but a continuous process of balancing the platform’s internal control and external contribution.
the boundary resources model provides a theoretical account of the relationship between platform control and third-party development.
